source: Real TTC subway alerts posted by @TTCnotices on X (TTC Service Alerts), Aug 8 to Nov 16, 2026, one per distinct alert (updates with only a time stamp or a closing line removed). Labels set by hand from the alert text alone, before comparing with the parser.
labelRules: line: the line named. stations: every station named, in model names (Bloor-Yonge is Bloor on Line 1 and Yonge on Line 2; Vaughan is Vaughan Metropolitan Centre). cause: the model cause group the text describes (security incident and police or TPS investigation: security; emergency alarm: alarm; mechanical issue: train; door problem: doors; operational problem: operations; communication issue: signals, as the TTC signal codes include train control communication; power shut off: power; trespasser at track level or on the tracks: track_person; an unspecified investigation: other). planned: planned work or maintenance, which gets no forecast.
split: development: the 51 older alerts (Aug 8 to Oct 15, 2026), used to find and fix parser errors; held out: the 51 newer alerts (Oct 15 to Nov 16, 2026), not used for fixes

station.note: correct means the one station named, or for alerts naming two or more stations, a choice listing exactly those stations

readyWithoutHelp.note: single station incident alerts where line, station and cause were all read correctly with no question asked
